meta.title: Nine black holes, one brief
meta.lede: Nine model-generated Three.js simulations of the same prompt, run on one machine, scored on a frozen 100-point rubric, then compared on elapsed time, tokens and session cost. Results describe these generations only.
meta.subject: Interactive 3D black hole simulation in a single index.html

firstDeliveryPolicy: Every session had one user task turn and no follow-ups; each graded file was last modified before its session completed.

confounders: The exhibit-3d skill sets effort: max; Claude Code honored it, so two Claude runs ran mostly at max instead of xhigh.
Harnesses, injected instructions, skills and output styles differed across vendors.
The evaluator (Claude Opus 5.5) shares a vendor with three submissions and is the same model as one.
limitations: One generation per model; not a general ranking.
All runs saturated the 120 Hz display, so performance cannot rank GPU headroom.
No verified bills; Claude TTFT not recorded; Gemini input and cache accounting unverified.

method.title: Runtime checks
method.text: Standardized gestures, slider min/default/max while paused, a 5 s pause with camera use, resume, narrow round trip; an in-page frame probe measured motion per frame.

method.title: Performance
method.text: Three trials per run with order rotated, fresh load, 5 s warm-up after the first draw call, 20 s rAF monitor. Measures browser frame cadence, not GPU time.

S4.keyFinding: Ray-marched lensing; thick over-bright disk; polished UI
strengths: Velocity-Verlet ray march with a volumetric slab disk and Kepler-lane sparks; polished UI with readouts, info dialog, hide-UI and shortcuts; adaptive resolution and robust error messages.
findings: Thick, puffy, near-white-clipped disk with a bulge below the shadow; background lensing deliberately localized and visually the weakest (A1–A3; still credited in C1).

S7.keyFinding: Ray-marched lensing; glare blob; best error handling
strengths: Verlet ray march in horizon units; capture mask carried past bloom keeps the shadow black; most complete error handling and pagehide disposal.
findings: Bloom glare blob at the upper right of the shadow and over-bright inner disk (A1–A3).
